steps.name: A Shortage of Energy (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Lapidem] on "Monster Tree Mountain", then find [Pulse] in "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Mighty grateful you're helping me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ain't nothin'. Tell me what... Wait, that's not how I talk... Anyway, I couldn't just pass by.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Thank you kindly. Your help restored some of the mountain's essence, but it still ain't enough.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Did you know? Monster Tree Mountain is the heart of the natural power flowing through Mirgandia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not really, but a shortage of essence means Mirgandia is more likely to become corrupted?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: That's right. We need a way to spread more pure, clean essence through the mountain. Then this place will be safer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll help Iris become a more complete god.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: The goddess has troubles of her own. Don't push her too hard. Just help me a little.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Used to be, if I put power into flowers blooming on the rocks, the mountain's essence would clear right up. But pollution's piled up over time, and now all this trouble...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Flowers alone won't do it anymore. If you know a mage who does plenty of research, go ask for advice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A mage who does a lot of research...

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I don't know much, but I reckon one of the cities you visited had someone mighty keen on magic.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, yes. There is someone. How did you know?

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Spend long enough with the earth, and you hear a few things through it. Hehe. A spirit's power, you might say.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Ah, listen to me ramble... This isn't urgent. Take your time.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: And don't tell them who I am. Just say some old fellow's troubled by a polluted mountain and needs help. Understood?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Much obliged. See you later.

steps.name: A Shortage of Energy (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Raunatun] in "Ra's Fortress" and obtain the <Cursed Heart>. Then report to [Pulse] in "Underground City Tartaros".

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (Pulse reads a book, unaware anyone is standing before him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello. Excuse me...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: What is it? I'm absorbed in a new book. You're interrupting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I may have brought something useful for your research.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Then I'll hear it and decide.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As Lapidem requested, you explain that an old man wants magic to cleanse his polluted mountain.)

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: If it needs magical assistance, it can't be an ordinary mountain.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Research into magic that purifies nature... I've wanted to try that. What an opportunity.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I'll undertake it. Please fetch the special materials I need. For ordinary work, the gems here would suffice, but...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: This requires combination and fusion. You might call it a form of alchemy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What materials do you need?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Records mention an object called a <Cursed Heart>, capable of controlling the power of life.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Apparently, it can be found somewhere in an Eastland desert... Let's talk once you've brought it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I know where. A little troublesome, but...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I'll wait. This should be interesting research.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: You've obtained the material. Well done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you waited long?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: No. You're right on time.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: An object that looks mysterious at a glance. Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (With a faint smile, Pulse takes the material and disappears somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's acting differently than usual. He really does love magical research.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (An enormous explosion suddenly erupts from the alley where Pulse disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the building Pulse went into...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: (Pulse slowly emerges, a disheveled mess from the explosion.)

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: My theory was perfect, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: My theory was perfect, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pulse...? Are you all right?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I'm fine... But I don't know where the research went wrong.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: I accounted for every variable, even the flow of mana, yet it failed... I'm ashamed.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: And I ruined the material you brought...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Should I get another?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: No. If I tried again now, the result would still be an explosion. Sigh...

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Frankly, I'm panicking. I hate to admit it, but someone else might offer a better answer.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Since you're from Lumen, you'll know her: Asma. Go and ask her. Just tell her Pulse said he was sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's all I need to say?

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Yes, nothing more. She doesn't usually take on such work, but she'll do it for me. Though she'll probably show an unusual expression...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you say so, I'll go see her.

lines.speaker: 펄스
lines.text: Thank you. I'd better clean up the room after that explosion. If I leave it, who knows what lecture Melvic will give me...

steps.name: A Shortage of Energy (4)
steps.objective: Obtain a <Vitality Tree Root> and <Tears of Vegetation>, then report to [Asma] in "Lumen".

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hello, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Asma. I've come with another favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Of course. Go ahead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pulse also had a message.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Pulse? The one in Tartaros?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her face seemed to freeze for a moment...)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It's not what you're thinking. ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Asma that an old man needs help using magic to purify his polluted mountain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Pulse says he's sorry he couldn't handle it.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: That isn't what he's sorry for. Don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what...?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Don't worry about it. ♬

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Right, right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The atmosphere definitely turned chilly. I'd better stay quiet.)

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: It's difficult to explain precisely, but the material seems to have changed a little when you took possession of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Changed?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Your power is outside the ordinary range. It seems to have affected the material as well.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: For better or worse.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... So it was my fault. I'm the one who should apologize to Pulse.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Don't worry. He probably realizes it already. His theory wasn't wrong; he simply discovered the variable called 'you' too late.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Instead, bring me some materials. First, a <Vitality Tree Root> and <Tears of Vegetation>.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll get them somehow.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Thank you.

steps.name: A Shortage of Energy (5)
steps.objective: Obtain a <Spirit's Soul> and <Origin of Wind>, then report to [Lapidem] on "Monster Tree Mountain".

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You've brought the materials.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Well done. These actually aren't for improving the mountain's essence.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? What are they for?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hear me out. Even if you gathered fresh materials and headed for the mountain, your condition might ruin them on the way.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I'll make a medicine to prevent that change. It won't take long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: (Asma goes inside, then returns with a packet of medicine.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It won't do anything strange to me, will it?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: The theory is perfect, so don't worry. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That makes me more nervous. Sigh... I'll take it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's good. Why does medicine taste like meat?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: That's a relief. If there'd been side effects, it would have tasted different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Hehe. Don't worry about it. Anyway, we need more materials.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since it tastes like meat, I'll forgive you. Sigh... What else do you need?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Get a <Spirit's Soul> from a dungeon on Merin Island, and an <Origin of Wind> from the Hall of Rest in the Amaloon Desert.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's a lot of traveling.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: You can manage it. Once you have everything, take it to the elderly spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh! You knew?

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Yes. Mir told me. Sometimes Mir visits for jerky and stops by to chat. The elderly spirit came up in conversation.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: I heard he was worried about making the mountain cleaner, so I'd been looking into it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. That makes things much easier.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Of course. Your work is for the continent and the world. Helping is only natural.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: See you later, Asma.

lines.speaker: 아스마
lines.text: Take care.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I felt a powerful presence from the mountain entrance and wondered who it was. It's you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Those things you're carrying will help me. Set them down here, would you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The person who advised me said to gather these and bring them to you, Lapidem.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What? There's a mage who knows me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You explain that Mir told Asma about Lapidem.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: When Mir visited, I went on about the mountain's essence. That child remembered.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: What a good child. I'll tell the mountain's little ones to prepare something tasty for the next visit.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: And the mage who figured this out is impressive, too. You're lucky, with good people around you. Treasure them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: Then I'll put my power into these things.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (A wind blows over the materials before Lapidem. It sharpens, crushing them into powder.)

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: (The powdered materials rise glittering on the wind, spreading across the mountain and all of Mirgandia.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh... The air feels cleaner.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I'm grateful. This is the duty the goddess gave me.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: I hope nothing else troubles this world...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure it'll be fine. I'll go finish my remaining work.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: All right. Take care.

lines.speaker: 라피뎀
lines.text: You may not know it, but there's much still ahead of you. Be careful...
